description.p: ksnip-pyqt6 is a PyQt6 port of ksnip, a screenshot and annotation tool. It captures the whole screen, a single screen, a rectangular area, the last selected area, the active window or the window under the cursor, and opens the result in an annotation editor.

The editor supports freehand drawing, lines, arrows, rectangles, ellipses, text boxes, numbered markers, stickers, image inserts and watermarks. Items can be moved, resized, rotated, cropped, duplicated and reordered, and the result can be exported to PNG, JPEG, BMP, WebP or SVG.

ul.li: Rectangular, full screen, current screen, active window and portal capture modes
Annotations with undo/redo, zoom and multiple tabs
Optional spell checking while typing text
OCR text recognition when a supported backend is installed
Command line options for scripted screenshots

description.p: First packaged release of the PyQt6 port.
